part_A_exact_Farkas_certificate.target: Exact algebraic singlet probabilities at optimal CHSH geometry
part_A_exact_Farkas_certificate.scope: Proves infeasibility of a single setting-independent distribution over the specified 16 deterministic local strategies for this exact target. It is not an exact certificate for the minimum measurement-dependent TV objective.

candidate_models.name: Hall local deterministic measurement-dependent model

reference.title: Local Deterministic Model of Singlet State Correlations Based on Relaxing Measurement Independence
reference.author: Michael J. W. Hall

candidate_models.reported_contribution: An explicit local deterministic model reproducing singlet correlations by relaxing measurement independence.
candidate_models.what_it_is_not: A complete spacetime dynamical theory of the origin of the setting-hidden-variable dependence.
required_next_work: Reconstruct the published model equations from the primary paper.
Verify its conditional distributions and response functions.
Check normalisation and no-signalling.
Identify its causal interpretation and physical implementation.
Derive predictions beyond the correlations used to construct it.

candidate_models.name: Invariant Set Theory

reference.title: Invariant Set Theory: Violating Measurement Independence without Fine Tuning, Conspiracy, Constraints on Free Will or Retrocausality
reference.author: Tim N. Palmer

candidate_models.reported_contribution: Proposes deterministic dynamics restricted to a cosmological invariant set with non-standard state-space geometry.
candidate_models.what_it_is_not: An established experimentally validated replacement for quantum theory.
required_next_work: Specify the state space and invariant set constructively.
Specify the dynamics and invariant measure.
Derive allowed measurement settings and outcome probabilities.
Demonstrate Born-rule recovery.
Derive quantitative departures from standard quantum theory.
Assess computability, stability and empirical falsifiability.

candidate_models.name: Cellular Automaton Interpretation

reference.title: The Cellular Automaton Interpretation of Quantum Mechanics
reference.author: Gerard 't Hooft

candidate_models.reported_contribution: Explores deterministic cellular-automaton-like underlying descriptions and the emergence of quantum formalism.
candidate_models.what_it_is_not: A demonstrated complete local Bell-experiment mechanism with a verified setting-conditioned probability law.
required_next_work: Specify microscopic degrees of freedom and update rules.
Define the relevant Bell source and detector subsystems.
Derive the effective quantum state and Born probabilities.
Derive measurement-setting dependence if invoked.
Check locality and relativistic compatibility.
Derive independently testable deviations or constraints.

candidate_models.name: Retrocausal measurement-dependence models

reference.title: Measurement-dependence cost for Bell nonlocality: causal vs retrocausal models
reference.authors: Michael J. W. Hall and Cyril Branciard

candidate_models.reported_contribution: Compares causal and retrocausal measurement-dependence simulations using information-theoretic costs.
required_next_work: Keep temporal causal direction explicit.
Compare measurement-dependence costs under matched assumptions.
Identify operational predictions distinguishing causal classes.

candidate_models.name: Supermeasured / invariant-set interpretation

reference.title: Supermeasured: Violating Bell-Statistical Independence Without Violating Physical Statistical Independence
reference.authors: Jonte R. Hance, Sabine Hossenfelder and Tim N. Palmer

candidate_models.reported_contribution: Argues that Bell statistical-independence violation need not be interpreted as ordinary physical setting-hidden-variable correlation in the proposed invariant-set framework.
candidate_models.what_it_is_not: A settled interpretation or independent empirical confirmation.
required_next_work: Formalise the distinction between Bell statistical independence and physical statistical independence.
Test the sampling assumptions.
Derive operationally distinguishable consequences.
Compare with conventional ontological-model definitions.

part_C_physical_mechanism_audit.reason: The literature contains explicit measurement-dependent correlation models and broader deterministic proposals. However, the current ASDE project has not derived a complete microscopic dynamical model that generates the required measurement dependence and independently predicts observations.
part_C_physical_mechanism_audit.research_decision: Do not select a preferred physical mechanism based on conceptual appeal or LLM consensus. Replicate published equations first, then test whether they constitute a complete physical model.

limitations: The exact Farkas certificate concerns measurement-independent local-polytope infeasibility for the specified CHSH target.
It is not an exact certificate for the minimum measurement-dependent maximum-pairwise-TV optimisation.
The arbitrary Bell engine enumerates deterministic local strategies and is exponential in the number of parties, settings and outcomes.
The general engine currently tests known local vertices; it does not automatically derive all facets of arbitrary Bell polytopes.
The physical mechanism assessment is literature-grounded but is not a new physical derivation.
No primary paper full-text equation replication was performed by this cell.
No raw Bell experiment dataset was analysed.
No CMB or early-universe model was derived.
No claim of proving superdeterminism is made.
